items.title: Smurfit Westrock (SW) Stock Slides After Q3 Results Expose Margin Strain
items.summary: Smurfit Westrock stock dropped 5.2% to US$40.33 after the Q3 2026 earnings release, even though the headline numbers landed solidly within the packaging playbook. The group delivered US$8.16b in revenue and US$0.42 in basic earnings per share, while adjusted EBITDA of US$1.205b kept margins in line with management’s guidance.
